title: [Lean] Derive the selected normalized-cost bound from explicit physical suppliers
body:
## Result and exact scope

For the exact selected context κ = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918, this Lean theorem derives a finite uniform A and cost(x) ≤ A n^(1−κ) volume(x) from the explicitly quantified complete state/domain, positive volume, uniform base-family/local-work and exact selected child suppliers. It supplies no unconditional operational construction or full integer-multiplication bit-cost theorem.

The theorem constructs the normalized envelope, proves global boundedness by strict child descent, obtains its recurrence and a finite uniform constant, then connects the exact profile to the selected exponent. Neither the desired scalar recurrence nor `native_bound` is assumed by the final assembly.

The explicit suppliers still include the complete admitted state and precision family, nonempty states at every positive width, positive natural volume, uniform bounds across entire base families, one complete non-child-work bound, and the exact selected child decomposition with child volume `parent / 14336`. Operational implementation/refinement, precision accounting and transfer to a full multiplication bit-cost theorem remain open.

## Existing checked evidence

The exact final source is `1445894f6bc7d157bd229f81d92f55313132025a95effc67102fc08b08c60c95`. Its independent native terminal is `dbe7ee9956ee973bd698233ba07cc7b9d69571873b1db10748314ab25a98cf3d`, with two standard-only axiom probes, no warnings and no new finite decision. The accepted sixteen-module source closure uses Lean 4.21.0 and Mathlib `308445d7985027f538e281e18df29ca16ede2ba3`.

Eight included exact sources total 55,714 bytes. `materialize_sources.py` fetches no data itself: it reconstructs all sixteen sources from those files and eight public prerequisites at fork commit `73ff839084f8c2761dc4213a2fd9e63a295dd8fb`. The README gives the explicit public Git fetch, deterministic materialization and topological Lean commands. The existing local reconstruction matched all sixteen accepted hashes. No source or proof was rerun for this submission preparation.

## Attribution and comparison

Prepared for James Chang with substantial OpenAI assistance. Apache-2.0 and all source headers are retained. PR585 rational checkpoints, PR605/799 real-enclosure lineage, the exact selected PR1094 profile and Lean/Mathlib/Batteries are credited in NOTICE and SOURCE_MANIFEST. PR1379/1641 parking results and PR1430 precision analysis remain complementary conditional interfaces. No novelty is claimed for supremum, strong induction or the general recurrence method.

A current bounded duplicate search found no PR naming the exact assembly theorem or normalized-envelope module. Nearby pricing and finite-assembly results do not supply this same complete physical-supplier-to-cost-bound implication; prior exact comparisons are retained. This is a scoped overlap check, not a global novelty certificate.

## CI and publication status

This is one coherent conditional theorem chunk, separate from Hosting and the all144 finite-owner certificate. Its existing accepted source bytes and historical receipts are preserved. No candidate-specific CI or relocated full-closure replay has been run before submission. CI will be inspected after publication; generic repository checks alone do not demonstrate this Lean closure was replayed.
